title: 1 ghanta deewar dhakela... kaam ZERO
description: Season 2 Episode 14: In physics, work needs force AND displacement in the direction of the force — otherwise it is zero, no matter how tired you are.
exam_focus: Boards/NEET: zero-work cases — the most-asked 1-marker of the chapter
concept: In physics, work needs force AND displacement in the direction of the force — otherwise it is zero, no matter how tired you are.
on_screen_cues: "W = F · d · cos θ" → "d = 0 ⇒ W = 0" → "θ = 90° ⇒ W = 0" → "Moon around Earth: gravity does ZERO work" → "NCERT XI Ch 5"
pinned_comment: Moon Earth ke chakkar lagata hai — Earth ki gravity Moon pe kitna kaam karti hai? (Hint: is video mein answer hai 😏)
suggested_titles: "1 ghanta deewar dhakela — kaam ZERO 😭" / "Work kya hai? Physics ka sabse misunderstood word"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [sighs] Chintu, maine 1 ghanta deewar ko pura zor lagake dhakela. Thak gayi. Kitna kaam kiya?
Chintu: [deadpan] Zero.
Gudiya: [sarcastic] Zero?! Main paseene se bheeg gayi!
Chintu: [cheerfully] Physics mein "kaam" ka matlab alag hai. Force lagao AUR cheez us direction mein HILE. Tab kaam.
Gudiya: [confused] Deewar nahi hili...
Chintu: [excited] Toh work ZERO. Force into displacement. Displacement zero, work zero.
Gudiya: [confused] Par meri energy toh gayi!
Chintu: [laughs] Woh tumhare muscles ke andar garmi ban gayi. Deewar pe kaam zero, tumhari body ke andar kaam bahut!
Gudiya: [curious] Ek aur. Main bag utha ke seedha 1 kilometre chali. Bag pe kaam?
Chintu: [mischievously] Tum bolo.
Gudiya: [confidently] Bahut! Bhaari bag tha!
Chintu: [deadpan] Zero.
Gudiya: [gasps] Phir zero?!
Chintu: [excited] Tumhara force UPAR tha, bag ki movement AAGE. 90 degree. Jab force aur movement 90 degree pe hain, kaam zero!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Toh kaam tabhi hota hai jab force ki direction mein cheez chale... warna free ki mehnat!
Chintu: [proudly] Exactly! W equals F d cos theta. Yahi ek formula pura chapter chala deta hai.
Gudiya: [curious] Toh mera body har second kitni energy kharch karta hai?
Chintu: [mischievously] Tum ek 100 watt ka bulb ho! Woh next video mein!
